r31-scout-union-as-labeler-unstable.why: 'union' is the union of D3-DISTINCT sets (a set merged into an earlier one contributes none of its own spans). The plain union of all spans in the half gives 0.4838.

graded-support-reliability-at-10.why: the harness's no-variance test is a float test (sqrt of a sum of squares == 0.0) on support fractions; a half whose values are all equal (e.g. all 1/5) can show ~1e-17 spread, so the pair is kept and contributes an r computed from rounding noise. With an exact test (integer vote counts) the pair is excluded, as the stated estimator says. Emulating the float test reproduces every committed value exactly (recompute_reliability.json, results.float_test).
